specimen: Cucumis sativus L. cv. Marketer leaf mesophyll; control and iron-deficient plants
method: Transmission electron microscopy of ultrathin sections; source Methods and Figure 3
permissionEvidence: Original article copyright notice links CC BY 4.0; permits reuse with credit. Figure 3 is credited to the article authors and has no separate third-party restriction. Source, author credit, license link and conversion notice are retained.
attribution: © 2015 Vigani, Faoro, Ferretti, Cantele, Maffi, Marelli, Maver, Murgia and Zocchi. PLOS ONE 10(6): e0129141, Figure 3. CC BY 4.0. PNG converted to pixel-identical lossless WebP; no crop, recolouring or synthesized structures.
alt: Authentic thin-section TEM of cucumber leaf mesophyll from Vigani et al. (2015), Figure 3. Panels A–C are controls; D–F are iron deficient. Visible chloroplasts contain thylakoid stacks; labelled mitochondria show internal cristae, and V marks vacuolar regions. Original black scale bars each represent 500 nm. Panels have different image scales: compare each object with the bar in its own panel.

scale.evidence: Original Figure 3 caption and visible bars in all six panels. Panels use different displayed magnifications.

visibleStructures: cell wall regions in overview panels
conversion: Lossless WebP; identical dimensions and decoded pixels to PNG, no crop.
